chunks: And regarding a man who swears an oath to the tax collector in order thereby to protect his wealth, he said: "Yes."

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.صَاحِبِ الْعُشُورِ: the collector of tithes or taxes

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to swear an oath to a tax collector in order to protect one’s wealth?
ai.summary: This hadith gives permission for a man to swear an oath to the tax collector in order to safeguard his property. It reflects a legal ruling concerning protection of wealth in a situation involving coercive or burdensome financial taking.
